name: Sailab Banik
headline: Software Engineer II at ZF Group, building LLM document intelligence in production.
statement: Three years building production software at ZF Group, the last two on LLM document systems: a platform adopted by 20+ business teams that cut manual review by 60%, and automated extraction across 3,000+ scanned engineering drawings. Python, FastAPI and React, owned from requirements to deployment.
